claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Oxacillin is a penicillin-class beta-lactam whose antibacterial target (bacterial cell wall synthesis) does not exist in human cells, so at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled human cancer cell line viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak effect attributable to nonspecific physicochemical toxicity rather than a genuine antiproliferative mechanism.
